scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 23 boards of eight live Deity Online Kristina (Sweden) Culture games of 2026-11-10 (140731Z, 144009Z, 152217Z, 153619Z, 160429Z, 161648Z-cont2, 164254Z, 165607Z), each the run's events.jsonl cut after the state frame whose decision record carries our science-denial war's order: the Formal-War denunciation of the racer (10 boards, 5 of them a declared friend on its renewal turn) or the declaration itself (13 boards, every 'Declaring war on X to deny the space race' in those why.logs). Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch at 7bae560031 with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with denial-war-needs-the-lane-edge. The off arm reproduces the live DENOUNCE or DECLARE order on 23/23; the on arm emits neither on 23/23 and journals 'Culture keeps the peace with X | denial-war-needs-the-lane-edge: ...' (18 under 1.2 times the rival's steady power, at 0.03-0.96x; 5 denunciations of a declared friend on its renewal turn, which the host still counted as a friend).
